PK Launcher for Android is a fork of MojoLauncher (by the MojoLauncher contributors), which is based on PojavLauncher (by the PojavLauncherTeam). It is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0. The complete source code, including our changes, is published on GitHub. Thank you to everyone who built them.
PK Launcher is not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Playing requires a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition.

Horizon, the Rust rewrite of Minecraft: Java Edition by the Horizon Team, has no Android build yet. Its own roadmap lists Android, iOS and the browser as long-term goals: touch controls, a mobile interface, packaging and loading your own game files are still missing. When an official Android build exists, PK Launcher will add it here, and it will need the same Microsoft account that owns Java Edition.
